subject: Meta^n public held-out final-evaluation identity and merge boundary

symptom2disease.candidate_identity: stored selected solve() script from the archive; the adapter re-executes that script on test cases
symptom2disease.one_shot_post_selection: supported by public orchestrator structure: test pass occurs in end-of-run reporting after adaptive archive construction; test score is stored in the result rather than used by archive selection
symptom2disease.scope: public initial-release execution contract; not cryptographic proof of unreleased pre-public paper-run bytes

lawbench_charge.search_surface: validation slice after first 200 training items
lawbench_charge.candidate_identity: stored selected solve() script from the archive; the adapter re-executes that script on test cases
lawbench_charge.one_shot_post_selection: supported by public orchestrator structure: test pass occurs in end-of-run reporting after adaptive archive construction; test score is stored in the result rather than used by archive selection
lawbench_charge.scope: public initial-release execution contract; not cryptographic proof of unreleased pre-public paper-run bytes

co_bench.outer_surface: non-dev complement of the same benchmark files
co_bench.oracle_outer_candidate_identity: for each task, the archive's dev-selected per-task-best trace/script is re-executed on the held-out non-dev instances
co_bench.merge_detail: before the test pass the public orchestrator may synthesize merge_oracle from per-task dev winners. Even with consolidate=false it fires when oracle_mean_score-best_before exceeds 0.05*archive.score_range(); when it fires it is added to the archive and becomes archive best. Therefore the later routine named 'single best chain' can evaluate a routed merge artifact rather than one evolutionary lineage.
co_bench.paper_metric_boundary: the paper reports archive-best and best single chain as distinct estimators, so any reproduction must record the pre-merge best-lineage id and merge_candidate_id separately; do not infer that the paper run itself fired this merge because the unreleased pre-public executable/result bundle is absent
co_bench.one_shot_post_selection: held-out non-dev evaluation occurs after adaptive archive construction in the public orchestrator, but candidate identity must be frozen pre-merge or explicitly labeled as routed portfolio to support a single-lineage claim
co_bench.scope: public initial-release execution contract; not cryptographic proof of unreleased pre-public paper-run bytes

audit_rule_update: For recursive-agent results, bind outer-test score to an immutable candidate identity and estimator class before evaluation: latest single lineage, best single lineage, per-task routed portfolio, or synthesized merge/router. A label such as 'best chain' is insufficient if end-of-run assembly can change archive.best_candidate before the test call.
